snippet.title: Flux Empyrean Trailer 1
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3843410?utm_source=yt1

Flux Empyrean is an open-world mystery where knowledge is your only form of progression. Sail a vast ocean planet, navigate by the stars, and uncover a forgotten past. Use instruments and logic to solve mysteries in this atmospheric, narrative-driven exploration game.
